description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Future Hunter Mode], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Ice, Water)], [(Ice/Water) Ability +30% Boost (15s)], and [Break Javelin Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Future Hunter Mode
description.text: Ice and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Ice/Water ability

description.name: (Ice/Water) Ability +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Ice and Water abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Break Javelin Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Break Javelin after using a Ice or Water ability
